test_compact_log_env_var: test that _get_compact_log returns True when SPDL_PIPELINE_COMPACT_LOG env var is set to 1
test_compact_log_caching: test that _get_compact_log caches the result and ignores subsequent env var changes
test_set_compact_log_override: test that _set_compact_log programmatically overrides the SPDL_PIPELINE_COMPACT_LOG environment variable
test_set_compact_log_reset: test that setting _set_compact_log to None resets to re-check the environment variable
test_create_task_compact_mode: test that create_task respects the compact log setting when running async failing coroutines
